notices: A saved choice is a preference, not a product change.
Demo pipelines and data are fictional.
Copper is an example palette, not the default.
MCP exposes tools and resources. It does not draw the interface by itself.
This lab is a documentation demo, not an installable product.
Legacy studies and Red interactive UI are optional additions.

state_grammar_v4.blocked: left hatch strip + double rule + × word + reason (never sole invert)
state_grammar_v4.identity_accent: brand + primary CTA only — never OK/BLOCKED

options.name: Main Bus Spine
options.mechanism: One vertical spine of pipeline stages; detail panes tap off at right angles
options.website: Product tour scroll follows the spine
options.narrow: Spine stays; taps become stacked rows
options.tradeoff: Long pipelines get tall
options.curation_rationale: Canonical linear pipeline reading path; adapts to stacked rows on narrow.

options.name: Bay Grid
options.mechanism: Fixed 12-col grid of equal bays; each step owns a bay; bays that need review carry a literal text badge [REVIEW]; DOM order = pipeline execution order, never row-major
options.tradeoff: Equal bays still flatten criticality except through badges; badge discipline is required or a gated step reads like an auto step
options.curation_rationale: Parallel scan grid; badge discipline carries criticality when bays are equal.

options.name: Three Rail
options.mechanism: Inputs rail | graph | results rail at fixed widths; a persistent one-line status strip runs under all three; narrow mode uses explicit labeled tab controls
options.job: Configure, run, read in one view
options.narrow: Rails become labeled tabs; the status strip stays visible above them; no horizontal scroll at 200% zoom
options.tradeoff: Center graph is cramped on laptops; status strip costs one row of height
options.curation_rationale: Configure/run/read rails with persistent status; becomes labeled tabs on narrow.

options.name: Island Field
options.mechanism: Independent pipelines as hard islands with wide negative space
options.tradeoff: Wastes space when many
options.curation_rationale: Separates concurrent pipelines with islands — multi-workload home.

options.name: Split Plan/Run
options.mechanism: Top: plan graph; bottom: run ledger synced by step
options.tradeoff: Two scroll areas
options.curation_rationale: Plan vs run comparison layout for review journeys.

options.name: Mono Ledger
options.mechanism: All mono, hierarchy by weight+caps only
options.tradeoff: Monotone for prose
options.curation_rationale: Pure mono ledger — baseline for dense ops reading.

options.name: Bracket Tags
options.mechanism: [NAME] tags as semantic type layer; tag vocabulary is generated from backend declarations, never hardcoded; undeclared values render [UNKNOWN]; tags expose their text without the literal brackets to assistive tech
options.tradeoff: Bracket noise; vocabulary is only as good as the backend declarations
options.curation_rationale: Semantic bracket tags from backend declarations (unknown stays UNKNOWN).

options.name: Human Label + Technical Subline
options.mechanism: Every step/field shows plain-language name first, exact id/command in mono beneath
options.narrow: Subline truncates with full value on focus
options.tradeoff: Two strings to maintain per item
options.curation_rationale: Human-first labels with technical sublines — non-terminal users.

options.name: Inverted Headers
options.mechanism: Black bars with white caps for sections
options.tradeoff: Heavy if overused
options.curation_rationale: Inverted section headers for fast skimming.

options.name: Glyph Prefix
options.mechanism: > ok, ! error, ? unknown as leading glyph + word
options.tradeoff: Needs legend
options.curation_rationale: Glyph+word state prefixes without relying on color.

options.name: Bus Index
options.mechanism: Vertical index of stages; current inverted
options.tradeoff: Long lists
options.curation_rationale: Stage bus index — default jump list.

options.name: Dependency Spine
options.mechanism: Two short declared lists around the current step: upstream producers and downstream consumers; text-only, keyboard reachable
options.job: Orient in large DAGs without a visual-only minimap
options.tradeoff: Needs real dependency edges; empty if undeclared
options.curation_rationale: Upstream/downstream orientation for large DAGs.

options.name: Step Pager
options.mechanism: Prev/next by dependency order with names
options.tradeoff: Branches need choice
options.curation_rationale: Linear prev/next walk for inspector flows.

options.name: District Tabs
options.mechanism: Top tabs generated only from declared lifecycle districts (Connect/Map/Run/Out); undeclared districts absent; Run lands on review queue
options.narrow: Bottom tab bar with full labels, not initials
options.tradeoff: Lifecycle tabs above 4–5 districts overflow or hide labels; extra districts get dumped into overflow menus that mobile users never open
options.curation_rationale: Lifecycle district tabs generated from declared districts.

options.name: Step Index Palette
options.mechanism: Visible button + shortcut opens type-ahead over every backend-declared step across pipelines; results are a labeled list
options.job: Jump to a named step without learning grid coordinates
options.app: Power navigation / Cmd-K sibling for steps
options.tradeoff: Requires declared step names; useless if names are opaque hashes
options.curation_rationale: Type-ahead step palette across pipelines (Cmd-K sibling).

options.name: Step Focus + Neighbours
options.mechanism: Selecting a step inverts it and outlines its declared inputs/outputs; others recede to hairline
options.job: See what a step depends on
options.tradeoff: Needs real dependency edges
options.curation_rationale: Selection shows declared neighbours — dependency-aware focus.

options.name: Review Gate
options.mechanism: Consequential action requires a staged review card
options.tradeoff: Every consequential action waits on a staged review; frequent operators pay latency on routine deploys and may route around the gate with unsafe shortcuts
options.curation_rationale: Mandatory review gate for consequential actions.

options.name: Capability-Gated Button
options.mechanism: Unavailable actions shown as aria-disabled controls with the reason rendered as real visible text (not title tooltip)
options.tradeoff: More text on screen; reason copy must be maintained per backend
options.curation_rationale: Unavailable actions stay visible with reason text.

options.name: Split Action
options.mechanism: Primary RUN plus an always-visible sibling DRY-RUN; the chevron menu holds only extra variants and has the accessible name 'run options'
options.tradeoff: Two visible buttons use more width; menu still hides rarer variants
options.curation_rationale: RUN + DRY-RUN siblings; extras in options menu.

options.name: Dry-Run First
options.mechanism: Primary action is preview; real run after
options.tradeoff: Extra step
options.curation_rationale: Preview-first primary action before real run.

options.name: Schema Form
options.mechanism: Auto-form from discovered input schema, typed fields
options.tradeoff: Schema quality dependent
options.curation_rationale: Schema-driven auto-form from discovered inputs.

options.name: Port Socket
options.mechanism: Inputs drawn as sockets on step edge; click to bind; the binding list is a first-class editing mode (each binding an editable list item), not just the narrow fallback
options.tradeoff: Socket clicks need precision; the list mode must stay as capable as the drawn mode
options.curation_rationale: Port socket wiring with first-class binding list mode.

options.name: Raw/Visual Twin
options.mechanism: Same config as form and as text, synced
options.tradeoff: Sync complexity
options.curation_rationale: Synced form/JSON twin for trust.

options.name: Inferred Defaults
options.mechanism: Prefilled from discovery, marked with literal text INFERRED (never weight or fill alone); consequential params (cost, delete) require explicit confirmation of any inferred value
options.tradeoff: Over-trust of inferred values; confirmation adds friction on consequential params
options.curation_rationale: Inferred defaults marked INFERRED; consequential confirm.

options.name: Validation Ledger
options.mechanism: All errors listed with jump links
options.tradeoff: List fatigue
options.curation_rationale: Validation ledger with jump links.

options.name: Hard Panel
options.mechanism: 1-3px frame, inverted title bar
options.tradeoff: Box heavy
options.curation_rationale: Hard panel with inverted title — default grouping.

options.name: Ported Box
options.mechanism: Frame broken at IN/OUT ports
options.tradeoff: Drawing cost
options.curation_rationale: Ported box that exposes I/O on the frame.

options.name: Accordion Deck
options.mechanism: Decks expand in place using native details/summary or full ARIA disclosure with visible focus; review actions (approve/reject) never live inside a collapsed deck
options.tradeoff: Hidden content when collapsed; stricter rule on what may be collapsed; for review actions use F11.01/F11.02 instead of collapsing them
options.curation_rationale: Accordion decks; review actions never collapsed inside.

options.name: Hatched Placeholder
options.mechanism: Hatch fill marks reserved/unavailable area
options.tradeoff: Must carry text
options.curation_rationale: Hatched placeholder for unsupported/reserved regions.

options.name: Tabbed Container
options.mechanism: Hard tabs on top edge with ARIA tablist; at narrow widths tabs stack instead of scroll-wrapping so none are off-screen
options.tradeoff: Hidden facets behind inactive tabs; stacked fallback uses vertical space
options.curation_rationale: Tabbed container; stacks on narrow (no off-screen scroll).

options.name: Mono Ledger Table
options.mechanism: Right-aligned mono numbers, rules every row
options.tradeoff: Wide mono ledgers force horizontal scroll on laptop workbench widths; operators comparing two numeric columns lose row alignment
options.curation_rationale: Mono ledger table with sticky first column.

options.name: Status Column First
options.mechanism: State column leftmost with glyph plus status word (or aria-label) so shape is never the only channel
options.tradeoff: Repetition; glyph+word uses more width
options.curation_rationale: Status-first column with glyph+word.

options.name: Diff Table
options.mechanism: Plan vs actual columns with delta
options.tradeoff: Needs baseline
options.curation_rationale: Plan vs actual diff table.

options.name: Expandable Row
options.mechanism: Row opens its log in a pinned panel or sheet with explicit focus management and Esc to close; no inline layout shift
options.tradeoff: Opening a panel is heavier than inline expand; focus return must be reliable
options.curation_rationale: Expandable row → pinned log panel (Esc to close).

options.name: Mapping Table
options.mechanism: Discovered field | proposed control | evidence | [CONFIRM] per row
options.tradeoff: Review effort for large schemas
options.curation_rationale: Schema→UI mapping table with evidence + confirm.

options.name: Orthogonal DAG
options.mechanism: Right-angle edges, layered layout
options.tradeoff: Layout complexity
options.curation_rationale: Orthogonal DAG — primary dependency view.

options.name: Swimlane Bus
options.mechanism: Lanes per resource, steps placed on lanes
options.tradeoff: Many resource lanes force a wide canvas; on narrow screens one-lane paging hides concurrent work and makes "who runs where" answers incomplete
options.curation_rationale: Swimlane bus for who/what runs where.

options.name: Lineage Ledger
options.mechanism: Declared field→field flows only as a ledger of rows (source field, step, dest field); no inferred braid; undeclared lineage shows [UNKNOWN]
options.job: Audit declared data lineage without fabricating topology
options.website: Story / docs when lineage is declared
options.tradeoff: Looks empty when backends do not declare field flows — that emptiness is honest
options.curation_rationale: Declared field lineage as ledger (no invented braid).

options.name: Island Topology
options.mechanism: Systems as islands; solid edge = backend-confirmed link; dashed = a proposal the user saved (never system-inferred); status always printed as text (CONNECTED / PROPOSED / UNKNOWN)
options.tradeoff: Must mark unknown; text labels add clutter
options.curation_rationale: Island topology with CONNECTED/PROPOSED/UNKNOWN text.

options.name: Unknown-aware Graph
options.mechanism: Undiscovered nodes drawn as [?] hatched
options.tradeoff: Looks incomplete
options.curation_rationale: Unknown-aware graph with hatched [? ] nodes.

options.name: Word+Glyph State
options.mechanism: [OK] [RUNNING] [BLOCKED] [UNKNOWN] text marks
options.tradeoff: Word+glyph marks add horizontal width in dense tables; DESIGN INTENT / UNTESTED whether truncated glyphs still meet the "state in words" baseline when columns squeeze
options.curation_rationale: Word+glyph state marks including BLOCKED/UNKNOWN.

options.name: Evidence Stamp
options.mechanism: State + source + time
options.tradeoff: Verbose
options.curation_rationale: Evidence stamp (state + source + time).

options.name: Capability Check Grid
options.mechanism: Grid of discovered capabilities: YES / NO / UNKNOWN + evidence line each (PC Glimmer F9.5)
options.job: Know what this pipeline can do
options.tradeoff: Verbose
options.curation_rationale: Capability check grid YES/NO/UNKNOWN + evidence.

options.name: Blocked Reason
options.mechanism: [BLOCKED] always with a reason line; when the backend gives none the line reads 'reason not provided by backend' (never invented)
options.tradeoff: Needs reason data; fallback text can feel unhelpful but is honest
options.curation_rationale: Blocked always carries reason (or honest fallback).

options.name: Freshness Stamp
options.mechanism: Age of status: 4s / stale
options.tradeoff: Clock math
options.curation_rationale: Freshness stamp to avoid stale trust.

options.name: Honest Empty
options.mechanism: Says why empty + one next step
options.tradeoff: Copy work
options.curation_rationale: Honest empty with one next step.

options.name: Discovery Scan
options.mechanism: Lists exactly what the backend declared and what was checked, as streaming text lines in a role=status polite region; inferred checks are not listed as results
options.tradeoff: Long discovery checklists bury the one failed probe under successful checks; failed probes sort first
options.curation_rationale: Discovery scan listing checked declarations.

options.name: Error Card w/ Retry
options.mechanism: What failed, raw message, retry options
options.tradeoff: Must not hide raw
options.curation_rationale: Error card with raw message + retry/edit.

options.name: Offline/Disconnected
options.mechanism: Explicit lost connection + last known
options.tradeoff: Shows last-known data, which users may still mistake for current
options.curation_rationale: Offline/disconnected with last-known timestamp.

options.name: Unsupported State
options.mechanism: Feature not supported by adaptor, why
options.tradeoff: Admits limits
options.curation_rationale: Unsupported adaptor capability with why.

options.name: Side Inspector
options.mechanism: Right drawer w/ step detail, graph stays
options.tradeoff: Side inspector steals graph width; on 13" laptops the canvas reflows and dependency edges re-layout mid-inspection
options.curation_rationale: Side inspector keeps graph in place.

options.name: Review Modal
options.mechanism: Focus-trapped review for consequential
options.tradeoff: Interrupts; desktop/tablet presentation; phone uses F14.08
options.curation_rationale: Focus-trapped review modal for consequential acts.

options.name: Error Trace Strip
options.mechanism: Persistent strip under the graph listing error chain for the focused step (what failed → evidence → jump); keyboard reachable, not hover-only
options.job: Read quick facts / failure context without tooltip hover
options.narrow: Strip becomes top sheet under header
options.tradeoff: Always occupies vertical space when errors exist
options.curation_rationale: Persistent error trace strip under graph.

options.name: Layer Toggle
options.mechanism: Show/hide layers (data, timing, errors) as switches with visible selected state in text; an always-visible failed-count badge stays when the errors layer is off
options.tradeoff: Hidden info when a layer is off; badge must never be hideable
options.curation_rationale: Layer toggles with always-visible failed count.

options.name: Capability Ledger
options.mechanism: Connect reveals exactly the backend-declared capabilities as a ledger (YES/NO/UNKNOWN + evidence); no gated unlock of later sections
options.job: Show what this pipeline can do immediately after connect
options.tradeoff: Long manifests; must not invent undeclared rows
options.curation_rationale: Capability ledger immediately after connect.

options.name: Slash Hatch
options.mechanism: / / / at 4ch rhythm
options.tradeoff: Not alone as meaning
options.curation_rationale: Slash hatch for reserved/disabled (never alone as meaning).

options.name: Missing-Tooth Comb Rule
options.mechanism: Comb rule where each tooth is a declared member of a one-to-many group; an absent tooth marks an optional or undeclared slot and is labeled in text as "n of m declared"; the rule is role=separator
options.job: Show group membership and absence, not only section rhythm
options.website: Divider with an intentional labeled gap
options.app: Grouping stages/fields that have optional members
options.narrow: Teeth collapse to the text "n of m declared"
options.tradeoff: The gap reads as a defect without its text label; sibling of F12.04 Belt Rule (which carries direction) so this one must carry membership only
options.curation_rationale: Missing-tooth comb for declared group membership.

options.name: Belt Rule
options.mechanism: ═══> directional rule
options.tradeoff: Only with real direction
options.curation_rationale: Belt rule for real direction.

options.name: Square Loop
options.mechanism: Closed orthogonal ring
options.tradeoff: Only cycles
options.curation_rationale: Square loop for declared cycles.

options.name: Underground Dash
options.mechanism: Dashed gap marks an optional or collapsed step that can be revealed (PC Glimmer)
options.tradeoff: Must never conceal errors or consent
options.curation_rationale: Underground dash for optional/collapsed steps.

options.name: Event Tick
options.mechanism: One glyph advances per real event
options.tradeoff: Needs events
options.curation_rationale: Event tick advances only on real events.

options.name: Hard Cut
options.mechanism: No easing; instant state change
options.tradeoff: Hard cuts feel abrupt during orientation; users mid-scroll can lose which node was focused when the frame swaps instantly
options.curation_rationale: Hard cut default transition (clarity over easing).

options.name: Dependency Trace
options.mechanism: On select, edges upstream trace once then hold as static highlight
options.tradeoff: One-shot only
options.curation_rationale: One-shot dependency trace on select.

options.name: Recorded Replay Scrubber
options.mechanism: Step through a past run's recorded events; never simulated
options.tradeoff: Needs event log
options.curation_rationale: Recorded replay scrubber — never simulated.

options.name: Hard-Cut Drilldown
options.mechanism: Instant cut from map to step with a breadcrumb back; no crop-zoom or fade animation
options.job: Drill into a step from the map without spatial zoom motion
options.tradeoff: Loses animated spatial continuity some users like
options.curation_rationale: Hard-cut drilldown map→step with breadcrumb.

options.name: Spine Collapse
options.mechanism: Graph → ordered list with named dependencies; parallel branches shown as indented blocks with n/m done counts
options.tradeoff: Linearization still flattens some spatial intuition; branch blocks mitigate but add height
options.curation_rationale: Spine collapse to ordered list with branch blocks.

options.name: Thumb Bar
options.mechanism: Primary actions in bottom bar 56px
options.tradeoff: Bottom thumb bars permanently consume vertical space; short phone viewports hide the step the operator is acting on
options.curation_rationale: Thumb bar primary actions (56px).

options.name: Run Ledger (phone)
options.mechanism: Scrollable monospace column in execution order; status glyph + name + duration; tap expands log; parallel branches as indented blocks with "n/m done"
options.job: Walk a run on phone with all siblings visible (no swipe carousel)
options.narrow: Native; this IS the narrow layout
options.tradeoff: Long runs scroll; no cinematic one-step focus
options.curation_rationale: Phone run ledger — no swipe carousel.

options.name: Big Hit Rows
options.mechanism: 44-56px rows w/ full-row tap
options.tradeoff: Density lost
options.curation_rationale: Big hit rows 44–56px.

options.name: Review Fullscreen
options.mechanism: Consequential review always fullscreen on phone
options.tradeoff: Extra screen for every risky step slows frequent operators; phone presentation of the F04.02 review gate and F11.02 modal, not a separate approval model
options.curation_rationale: Fullscreen review on phone for consequential.

options.name: Install Line Hero
options.mechanism: Hero shows one install command AND a primary GUI connect path; copy button with aria-live confirmation
options.tradeoff: Two paths to maintain; GUI path must not invent capabilities
options.curation_rationale: Install command + GUI connect dual path.

options.name: Before/After Pipeline
options.mechanism: Left: raw CLI text, right: Jaryo view for one real run (e.g. deploy); both panels show only backend-declared capabilities; stacked with a text alternative for the Jaryo panel on narrow
options.tradeoff: Needs an honest example; text alternative must match the picture
options.curation_rationale: Before/after CLI vs Jaryo for one real run shape.

options.name: Connect Demo
options.mechanism: Interactive fake pipeline clearly labelled DEMO and scoped to one real adapter's declared capability set; keyboard operable with managed focus
options.tradeoff: Must be labelled demo; scope to one adapter limits what it can show
options.curation_rationale: Labeled DEMO connect playground (one adapter scope).

options.name: Capability Table
options.mechanism: What adaptors can/can't expose
options.tradeoff: Honest but dry
options.curation_rationale: Capability honesty table.

options.name: Integration Islands
options.mechanism: CLI / MCP / SDK as islands; each marked PROPOSED or SHIPPED per backend declaration; exposed as a labeled list for assistive tech
options.tradeoff: Must say 'proposed'; labels must be kept current
options.curation_rationale: Integration islands CLI/MCP/SDK with PROPOSED/SHIPPED.

options.name: Command Palette
options.mechanism: Cmd-K list of actions with capability gating; plus a visible always-reachable button; ARIA combobox semantics; live-region announcement of result count on filter change
options.tradeoff: Gating can hide actions the user expects; visible button costs chrome
options.curation_rationale: Capability-gated command palette + visible button.

options.name: Plain-Language Find
options.mechanism: Type 'failed loads today' -> filter chips to confirm; chips are limited to backend-declared facets and fall back to the literal text on any parse miss; parse errors are shown as text
options.tradeoff: Parse errors visible; some natural phrases will fall back to literal search
options.curation_rationale: Plain-language find → confirmable chips.

options.name: Action Discovery Panel
options.mechanism: Lists everything adaptor supports
options.tradeoff: Long capability dumps duplicate F09.03 Check Grid density; newcomers skim and miss the few NO/UNKNOWN rows that block their job
options.curation_rationale: Action discovery panel of adaptor support.

options.name: Filter Chips Row
options.mechanism: Wrapping chips with aria-pressed per chip; stable DOM order across wraps; active state is inverted fill plus a text cue such as [ON]; result count announced in a polite live region
options.tradeoff: Many chips; two cues for active state use more width
options.curation_rationale: Filter chips with aria-pressed + text ON cue.

options.name: CLI Mirror
options.mechanism: Each GUI action shows its equivalent command only when the adapter declares CLI parity; consequential commands say 'review required in app'
options.tradeoff: Optional; hidden for actions with no declared CLI parity
options.curation_rationale: CLI mirror only when adapter declares parity.

options.name: Copper Workshop
options.mechanism: dark / warm single identity (fills only on brand+primary CTA) / cool-desaturated status tints
options.job: Copper = brand mark + the one primary CTA per view. Status tints come from a separate cool/desaturated family so copper never reads as 'running' or 'warning'.
options.app: Product UI under chosen color system
options.narrow: Same tokens; touch targets and mono fallback apply
options.tradeoff: Warm accent can still read 'warning' next to a salmon blocked tint; blocked is always a filled panel with [BLOCKED] + ✕ + reason line.
options.curation_rationale: EXAMPLE ONLY — Copper Workshop warm identity; not a chosen default.
options.mono_fallback: Copper→#fff fill, tints→#fff text; ✕ hatch retained; invert selection + dashed focus.

status.run: ▶ + word [RUNNING] + inverted row (static equivalent for reduced-motion)

color_independent_signals.selection_focus_unavailable: Selection = inverted fill; focus = outer dashed ring in focus_ring token; unavailable = dashed border + reason line.

options.name: Blueprint Paper
options.mechanism: light / cool white / blue = REFERENCES only (ids, coordinates, links, focus)
options.job: Blue marks things you can point at: step ids, schema paths, links, the focus ring. Body and status are ink. Blocked = inverted ink panel.
options.app: Product UI under chosen color system
options.narrow: Same tokens; touch targets and mono fallback apply
options.tradeoff: Looks like docs more than an app; add a real surface hierarchy via rules, not tint.
options.curation_rationale: Blueprint Paper cool paper system — distinct from copper.

status.run: ▶ + word [RUNNING] + inverted row (static equivalent for reduced-motion)

color_independent_signals.selection_focus_unavailable: Selection = inverted fill; focus = outer dashed ring in focus_ring token; unavailable = dashed border + reason line.

options.name: Cursor Signal
options.mechanism: dark / near-mono / ONE hot hue (magenta) reserved for 'where you are' (focus, cursor, selection pointer)
options.job: Magenta appears exactly once per screen: the focus/cursor. Everything else is Jaryo ink. Running uses an animated chevron whose reduced-motion form is static [RUN].
options.app: Product UI under chosen color system
options.narrow: Same tokens; touch targets and mono fallback apply
options.tradeoff: Almost no brand color; marketing may find it austere. Magenta ring on white panels needs ≥3:1 (checked).
options.curation_rationale: Cursor Signal — selection/focus grammar stress test.
options.mono_fallback: Magenta ring→2px dashed white ring; nothing else changes.

status.run: ▶ + word [RUNNING] + inverted row (static equivalent for reduced-motion)

color_independent_signals.selection_focus_unavailable: Selection = inverted fill; focus = outer dashed ring in focus_ring token; unavailable = dashed border + reason line.

options.name: Hazard Stripe
options.mechanism: dark / yellow hatch reserved for CONSEQUENTIAL chrome (review gate, destructive confirm) only
options.job: Yellow/black diagonal hatch appears only on Review Gate headers, destructive confirms and irreversible-step markers. BLOCKED is NOT hazard: it is a grey panel with ✕ and a hard border so 'needs a human' (hazard) ≠ 'cannot proceed' (blocked).
options.app: Product UI under chosen color system
options.narrow: Same tokens; touch targets and mono fallback apply
options.tradeoff: Overuse trains alarm blindness: hazard on idle chrome is forbidden. Hatch is visually loud at small sizes — min 24px band.
options.curation_rationale: Hazard Stripe — blocked/review emphasis without traffic-light OK.

status.run: ▶ + word [RUNNING] + inverted row (static equivalent for reduced-motion)

color_independent_signals.selection_focus_unavailable: Selection = inverted fill; focus = outer dashed ring in focus_ring token; unavailable = dashed border + reason line.

options.name: Terminal Phosphor
options.mechanism: dark / single-hue LUMINANCE LADDER (green) / amber cursor; hierarchy by brightness steps
options.job: One hue, 4 brightness steps: text #B8FFC8 > accent #33FF66 > muted #4DBF6A > border #2F8A49. Selection inverts to bright green. Amber is the cursor only.
options.app: Product UI under chosen color system
options.narrow: Same tokens; touch targets and mono fallback apply
options.tradeoff: Green-on-black is the classic CRT look but long reading is tiring; offer F17.06 as the 'calm' alternative.
options.curation_rationale: Terminal Phosphor — ops console dialect with mono fallback.

status.run: ▶ + word [RUNNING] + inverted row (static equivalent for reduced-motion)

color_independent_signals.selection_focus_unavailable: Selection = inverted fill; focus = outer dashed ring in focus_ring token; unavailable = dashed border + reason line.

options.name: Mendacity Void Cue
options.mechanism: Near-empty black stage; one focal actor; a single hard directional mark (arrow/plate) carries wayfinding. No ornamental chrome.
options.job: Focus attention when the system is waiting or the user must move once
options.app: Empty / loading / 'next step' gate (pairs with F10)
options.narrow: Cue becomes a 44px bottom plate; stage crops, never letterboxes with dead side gutters that scroll
options.tradeoff: Too little chrome can hide system status; pair with a one-line status strip
options.curation_rationale: Keeps Mendacity's strongest idea — extreme negative space + one directional cue — inside Jaryo mono grammar.

improved: Replaced mixed atmospheric art with machine-plate mono
Made the directional cue a first-class control (≥44px on narrow)
Added explicit pairing with a status strip so emptiness ≠ silence
Dark/light via lab theme tokens; reduced-motion: no particle reliance

options.name: Mendacity Combat Ledger
options.mechanism: Portrait disc + mono ledger rows (HP/MP or RUN/OK) + weapon/key legend as a hatched plate. Serif mix removed; hierarchy by weight and caps only.
options.job: Read vitals and bindings at a glance during a live session
options.narrow: Portrait 40px; ledger stacks under it; legend collapses behind a [KEYS] disclosure (≥44px)
options.tradeoff: Portrait costs width on 260px; disclosure hides bindings until opened
options.curation_rationale: Modernizes Mendacity's portrait+percentage HUD into a Jaryo mono ledger with adaptive disclosure.

improved: Unified type to mono ledger (no mixed serif/sans)
Percent rows become aligned tokens
